interface_matches_spec.detail: Module ports match spec exactly: MemRW[1:0], Funct3[2:0], AddrLSB[1:0], StoreData[31:0], ReadData[31:0], WriteData[31:0], ByteEnable[3:0], LoadData[31:0].

defaults.detail: WriteData=0, ByteEnable=4'b0000, LoadData=0 set unconditionally at top of always_comb block before any conditional. Satisfies spec §Deterministic Defaults.

memrw_encoding.detail: MemRW==2'b01 activates store path; MemRW==2'b10 activates load path; MemRW==2'b00 and 2'b11 produce zero defaults. Matches spec table.

store_sb.detail: SB (Funct3=000) places StoreData[7:0] into the byte lane selected by AddrLSB[1:0] with correct ByteEnable one-hot encoding (0001/0010/0100/1000).

store_sh.detail: SH (Funct3=001) uses AddrLSB[1] to select lower (ByteEnable=0011, WriteData[15:0]) or upper (ByteEnable=1100, WriteData[31:16]) halfword lane.

load_lb.detail: LB (Funct3=000) sign-extends sel_byte (selected by AddrLSB case) to 32 bits via {{24{sel_byte[7]}}, sel_byte}.

load_lh.detail: LH (Funct3=001) sign-extends sel_half (AddrLSB[1] mux) to 32 bits via {{16{sel_half[15]}}, sel_half}.

load_lw.detail: LW (Funct3=010) passes ReadData[31:0] straight through to LoadData.

byte_lane_selection.detail: sel_byte case covers all four AddrLSB values (00→[7:0], 01→[15:8], 10→[23:16], 11→[31:24]). sel_half uses AddrLSB[1] correctly for aligned halfword.

icarus_warnings.detail: Icarus emits 'sorry: constant selects in always_* processes are not currently supported' for the part-select expressions (ReadData[7:0], ReadData[15:8], etc.) inside always_comb. This is a known Icarus 12 limitation with static part-selects inside always_comb; the tool still compiles and simulates correctly as shown by RESULT: PASS. These are tool warnings, not RTL bugs. No RTL change required.

synthesizability.detail: Module is pure combinational (always_comb, no clock/reset). All signals are fully assigned (defaults + conditionals). No latches inferred. Compatible with downstream synthesis.

diagnosis: Simulation passed with 75/75 tests across all 7 test sections (no-access defaults, unused MemRW encoding, SB/SH/SW stores, LB/LH/LW/LBU/LHU loads, path isolation, corner cases, and spec verbatim examples). RTL is functionally correct and specification-compliant. The repeated Icarus 'constant selects in always_*' warnings are a simulator limitation, not a design defect — compilation and simulation both returned exit code 0.
action: NO_CHANGE — RTL is correct; no edit applied.
